newsitem.title: USA: Worldcom, Deutsche Telekom ink interconnect pact.
newsitem.headline: Worldcom, Deutsche Telekom ink interconnect pact.

text.p: WorldCom Inc said Wednesday that its German operating company has signed an interconnect agreement with Deutsche Telekom AG, giving it access to that company's national network.

The company said the interconnect agreement, the first of its kind to be signed in Germany, is expected to begin Jan 1, 1998, and positions WorldCom to participate in the liberalized European market for telecommunications which begins then.
The agreement, including the necessary request to authorize the interconnect tariff, has been presented to German regulators for ratification, said WorldCom.

Interconnection with Deutsche Telekom will allow WorldCom to become a national public telecommunications operator in Germany, said the company. It will also provide WorldCom customers with the reach of Deutsche Telekom's national network and the German company's customers access to the services available over WorldCom's network.
WorldCom has operating subsidiaries in Germany, the UK, France, Belgium, Italy, The Netherlands, Switzerland and Sweden. In total it operates in more than 50 countries worldwide.
